steps.title: Login screen — initial state
steps.notes: Assertion-only step confirming the initial login screen state, per flow/userLogin.md Step 1.

steps.title: Continue with password — password screen
steps.notes: Phone-number EditText has no content-desc/text of its own (per loginFlow.plan.json step 3), so the '+91' country-code badge is used as the tap selector to focus it before typing, matching the previously-verified loginFlow pattern. Entering the number before tapping 'Continue with password' is what pre-fills the phone-number field shown on the resulting password screen.

steps.title: Successful login — Home page
steps.notes: Per flow/userLogin.md Step 3: 'user re-opens the password screen (back → Continue with password)' before entering the correct password — back returns to the login screen with the phone number retained, then re-tapping Continue with password re-opens a fresh password screen with an empty, auto-focused password field, matching the identical pattern already verified live in loginFlow.plan.json step 7. Post-login 'Unauthenticated App Detected'/notification-permission prompts (application/known-behaviors.md) are known non-blocking quirks, not asserted here.
